[README](https://github.com/NASA-EarthRISE/training_Getting_started_with_GEDI_spaceborne_lidar/blob/main/tutorials/Local_biomass_modelling/README.md) for Local Biomass Modelling Exercises

![][image1]

Please refer to the [training slides to complete exercises](https://github.com/NASA-EarthRISE/training_Getting_started_with_GEDI_spaceborne_lidar/blob/main/GEDI_training_Numata.pdf).

Slides for Exercise 1 (GEDI waveform simulation/extraction of simulated waveforms): 14-19

* Exercise 1 can be run in RStudio or Colab with R runtime type selected.  
  Slides for Exercise 2 (local AGB model development): 20-28  
* Exercise 2 can be run in RStudio or Colab with R runtime type selected.  
  Slides for Exercise 3 (AGB mapping): 29-37  
* Exercise 3 can be run in the JavaScript API of Google Earth Engine, which requires an [account](https://earthengine.google.com/).  
    
  All training materials for these exercises [can be found in the following link](https://github.com/NASA-EarthRISE/training_Getting_started_with_GEDI_spaceborne_lidar/tree/main/tutorials/Local_biomass_modelling).
